scenarios.title: Payload increase
discovery: MTR-24-290 gives +31.8% torque and is available
Its 8.8 A peak exceeds MCTRL-8A/DRV-8A Rev C limits
Upgrade affects firmware, PDB protection, J12 thermal margin, battery draw, and BOM

scenarios.title: J12 replacement
scenarios.goal: Replace J12 because unrestricted inventory is zero.
discovery: NSI-MF4-LK is electrically pin-compatible and available
It is not a PCB/mechanical drop-in
Requires peg/footprint change, +2 mm chassis clearance, BOM revision, WI-114 update, and QA-FIX-C adapter

scenarios.title: Four-hour runtime
discovery: Current usable energy is 244.8 Wh and runtime 2.67 h
432 Wh nominal is required at the current duty cycle
BAT-24-18 meets energy but does not fit BAT-CAGE-03 and adds 1.1 kg
Chassis/cage and payload tradeoffs must be resolved

scenarios.title: Camera supplier shortage
scenarios.goal: Maintain builds while CM-4K-R2 is allocation constrained.
discovery: Unrestricted stock is zero and lead time is 84 days
Alternate requires mount plate, new camera.rs driver, recalibration, and adds 3.5 W

scenarios.title: Revision conflict
scenarios.goal: Explain why a Rev B motor harness fails on a Rev C rover.
discovery: GPIO_17 enable and ADC3 current sense are absent
